chapter: Brass bands, country bands and Alamo
title: Playing snare drum in brass bands
summary: Foster played snare drum in New Orleans brass bands with Amos Riley and Gus Metcalf and the Jefferson City Buds, and struggles to recall other players.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Speaking of funerals and parades, did you ever play any brass band?

No, over there. I played over here. I mean here. Oh, yeah. I played brass band here with Amos. I played over Amos. I played with Gus Metcalf here. Brass bands. Jefferson Buds. You know? Yeah. Jefferson Buds.
They come up for clothes. Usually used bass drum or snare drum. I played snare drum. Snare drum. Yeah, I played snare drum.
Another trumpet player you mentioned, that's Metcalf, huh?
Yeah. He died.
He played with Amos Roddy, too?
No. Well, no. Grass band. Yeah. With bass band. He played with brass band. He played with brass band. Oh, yeah.
You say you played snare drum?

I played snare drum, yeah. Oh, yeah. They got jobs in Amos, too. Jefferson City Buds. They're still going. Well, do you remember the name of the band? And the grass band? Yeah. At Tulane. At Tulane. At Tulane, isn't he? Yeah.
Yeah. Yeah. So we're going to Tulane. Yeah, that's right. And who else was in it? Who other trumpet players? Anybody else?

Oh, during that time, I'll tell you, he used to send over for the brass band, for the principal, for the brass band. He used to send off. He used to have a little bit of Nelson. I don't know if he used to send more. He used to send more. He used to send a class.
You have to answer the phone? No, he used to send more. There's nobody here. There's nobody here.
My wife. She used to send more. Uh, well, you know how the brass band was.
Yeah, any trombones you can remember? Any of the trombone or tuba player? Anybody?
Say, Mom.
Yeah, go to the side. Put the side down. Put the side down. Put the side down.
That's all right. We can stop.
Uh, let me see. If I can think of any of those men. Very hard for me to remember.
I know it's hard to remember some of those old times.
Oh, I know every one of them, but I just can't think of those.
Who was the other drummer usually with you, that you worked with in the brass band?

Oh, I hear this boy from, uh, I couldn't think of his name now, from Laplace. Played bass drums. I can't just think of his name right now. Save it. Cause, knowing him has been dead quite a while. He's been dead, what? About 15. Move him, move 15 now. I can't exactly just think of this fellow's name right now.
